King of the Hill2003

2003 series · Patch Boomhauer · directed by Anthony Lioi

Does Brad Pitt die in King of the Hill?

He plays Patch Boomhauer, a voice role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Dumped at the altar for being a sleaze.

Boomhauer's womanizing brother Patch rolls into Arlen in a Saab convertible to marry Katherine (Laura Dern), Boomhauer's old flame. Boomhauer quits as best man and Hank steps in, assuming Boomhauer is sabotaging the wedding, until it becomes clear Patch is the one sneaking around. When Patch blurts out the truth, Katherine hands back the ring and calls off the engagement. Patch is left humiliated but alive.

Season 8 premiere, aired November 2, 2003. Pitt, a fan of the show, pitched the idea of voicing Boomhauer's brother; the character speaks in the same Boomhauer mumble.
